objective: Vendor the embodied-agent-runtime repository into this one as the ROS 2 execution plane, so the evidence plane and the execution plane are reviewable in a single diff without merging their claims.
acceptance: the eleven ROS 2 packages are vendored with no source changes
the runtime's own docs, history and Dockerfile/Makefile move with it
ros2-ci.yml becomes ros2-runtime.yml, path-filtered to the runtime directory
the root READMEs and pyproject explain the two planes
ruff excludes the vendored tree because colcon/ament_lint governs its style
a Python-only change does not build the ROS 2 runtime
the full pytest suite matches the pre-existing environmental baseline with no new failures
evidence: 12 failed, 2695 passed, 5 skipped — byte-identical to the origin/main baseline, all environmental
stop_conditions: the move would require editing the ROS 2 package sources
a schema under interfaces/ would have to change
a Python evidence-plane module would have to import the vendored tree
